sources.title: README.md
sources.locator: What is this; More features; Quick start; FAQ; Roadmap; Tech stack; Security
sources.finding: Free Electron app on three desktop OSes owns lead/teammate orchestration, tasks, comments, messaging, review diffs, optional worktrees and token/cost analytics. Runtime subscriptions/API keys are reused. Cloud 24/7 and account switching are roadmap items, not current cloud execution.

sources.title: LICENSE
sources.locator: GNU Affero General Public License Version 3 and application notice
sources.finding: Repository application license is AGPL-3.0. The CLA does not replace that public license.

sources.title: src/main/services/schedule/SchedulerService.ts
sources.locator: SchedulerService timer, due-run admission and executor call
sources.finding: Pinned scheduler implementation uses due-run checks and nextRunAt to dispatch persisted schedules through the executor. Renderer schedule components expose configuration, linking it to an accessible product feature.

sources.title: src/main/services/schedule/ScheduledTaskExecutor.ts
sources.finding: Pinned scheduled executor resolves runtime binary, spawns with prompt, tracks process, persists output/result and offers cancellation. Supported Claude launch accepts max-budget-usd.

sources.title: v2.18.6
sources.finding: v2.18.6 was published 2026-11-05. Release notes describe the scoped changes; this is not a hands-on check.

sources.title: Agent Teams settings: Privacy telemetry toggle
sources.locator: src/renderer/components/settings/sections/GeneralSection.tsx lines 623-637; label text in src/features/localization/renderer/locales/en/settings.json lines 321-322, commit 63166ea
sources.finding: Settings, General, Privacy shows a Send anonymous telemetry toggle (crash, performance and product usage data) bound to general.telemetryEnabled whenever telemetry is built in. The same toggle is present at release tag v2.18.6.

sources.title: Agent Teams main-process telemetry gate
sources.locator: src/main/sentry.ts lines 85-114 (telemetryAllowed, syncTelemetryFlag, filterSentryEventForTelemetry); default in src/main/services/infrastructure/ConfigManager.ts line 403, commit 63166ea
sources.finding: The persisted telemetryEnabled flag is read before Sentry starts; turning it off shuts Sentry down and drops events. The default configuration sets telemetryEnabled to true, so telemetry is on until the user disables it.

sources.title: Agent Teams README FAQ: parallel teams
sources.locator: README.md line 389 (FAQ on running multiple teams), commit 63166ea
sources.finding: Multiple teams can run in one or several projects at once; git worktree isolation can be enabled for selected teammates at launch, and branch or merge rules are left to the provisioning prompt.
